title: 第五章 天地不移，江流石不转！
slug: 傲世九重天全本免费-傲世九重天最新章节列表
content_zh:
天外楼，九峰一园。有天外楼第七代十大弟子分别执掌；云来锋、云雾峰、云渺峰、云开峰、聚云峰、锁云峰、梦云峰、恨云峰、踏云峰、紫竹园。
聚云峰，便是宗主乌云凉所在之峰，乃是九峰之主峰。一园，便是楚阳所在的紫竹园。九峰一园之中，紫竹园的风景虽然最是优美，但资源却是九地之末。
紫竹园之主孟超然乃是十大弟子之中最小的师弟，生性淡泊，与世无争。从来不与九位师兄争什么，平生也只收了石千山、楚阳、谈昙三位弟子。
除却石千山是碍于情面不得不收之外，楚阳与谈昙皆是孟超然捡来的孤儿。
每一代弟子之中，都会从内门弟子之中选出十大弟子；作为各自九峰一园的掌舵人。而十大弟子之中的大师兄，便是天外楼未来的掌门人选，雄踞聚云峰。
不管是灵药资源还是灵气密集程度，聚云峰都是九峰之首。
为了这十大弟子的位置，九峰一园的弟子彼此争斗了数百年；每个人，都为了这十个名额拼命苦修。在这样的激励和压力之下，天外楼的弟子的修为也都是突飞猛进。
这个世界，名为九重天大陆。天外楼所在的，就是下三天。或称为“下天大陆”，在普通人眼中，在下天大陆，有几个神秘的地方，终年云雾弥漫，无论人畜，甚至是飞鸟，都不能接近。
唯有一些修为高超的武者才知道，那里，便是超脱下三天进入中三天的入口。
在中三天，同样也存在这样神秘的地方。便是上三天的入口！
想要进入，必须具有超脱于所在世界的功力才可以！
九重天大陆，顾名思义，这个大陆庞大之极，从东到西，历来不知多远，从南到北，从无记载到底有多遥。茫茫无际！
在这辽阔的大陆上，有着数不尽的传说，数不尽的神话，一代一代的流传。自古以来，帝王将相不知几许，英雄豪杰层出不穷。
今日金樽红酒看歌舞，明朝铁锁加身为死囚。今日皇帝，未必不是明日败军之将，刀下之鬼。今日寇贼，谁说明日不会黄袍加身面南背北为霸主？
在这片神奇的大陆上，任何事情，都有可能发生！
与任何的大陆星球一样，在朝堂之外，也有边缘，也有游侠儿，也有江湖人。有江湖，就有正反面，就有邪正之分。
正邪不两立，彼此之间的斗争也是层出不穷。在漫长的斗争中，也各自形成了自己的体系功法行事准则，或者在某一时间段打得天翻地覆，或者也在某一时间段数百年相安无事。
世事，本就是这么奇妙。
不管正邪魔道，在寻常世人眼中，却有一个共同的称呼：武道武者！
侠以武犯禁，无论在什么世界，都是一样的道理。武，这个字，包含万千。其中最为让人所牢记的，无非便是暴力二字！

一言不合，七步溅血，是为武。横刀立马，建功立业，是为武。纵意江湖，杀人越货，是为武……
武，多姿多彩，也多纷争。
除却人类之外，这个世界还有一些神秘的种族，比如天地人三星圣族。据说多少年前也曾辉煌一时，并且具有奇特的天赋能力，也曾与人类争霸天下，分庭抗礼。但却在很久很久以前就已经没落了。
或者还有什么别的种族，但，那些比传说还要飘渺……
至少，楚阳在前世一生的时间里，见过的，屈指可数。而且全是低级的圣族，至于高级的，则是一个没有见。不知是彻底灭绝了还是隐匿在某一个地方……
而人类武者，无论正邪哪一行，指、掌、腿、脚、拳、刀、剑、………等等所有种类，都是从徒、士、者、师、宗、尊、王、帝（皇）、君、圣……最后至高无上的，便是至尊！
十一个阶位，每一个阶位，都分为一到九品。
拳掌功夫，便是统称为武。武徒、武士、武者、武师、武宗、武尊、武王、武皇、武君，武圣。
换做刀道，便是刀徒、刀士、……刀圣！
唯有剑道，一开始都是一样，但在皇级的时候，却是“帝”；这是第一届九劫剑主的规定，没有人知道为什么。
到了圣级，基本就已经是天下巅峰！因为自古至今能够成为至尊的，寥寥无几！可以说，至尊，就是神话！据传说，至尊的层次，可呼风唤雨遨游天际，可移山填海破碎虚空！
但传说始终就只是传说。从来没有人亲眼见过！甚至圣级，也向来是神龙见首而不见尾。鲜有人见到。

content_en:
Tianwai Tower, nine peaks and one garden. There are ten disciples of the seventh generation of Tianwai Tower who are in charge respectively; Yunlaifeng, Yunwu Peak, Yunmiao Peak, Yunkai Peak, Juyun Peak, Suoyun Peak, Mengyun Peak, Hengyun Peak, Tayun Peak, and Zizhuyuan.
Juyun Peak is the peak where the sect leader Wu Yunliang is located, and it is the main peak of the nine peaks. The first garden is the Purple Bamboo Garden where Chu Yang is located. Among the Nine Peaks Garden, although the scenery of the Purple Bamboo Garden is the most beautiful, its resources are at the bottom of the Nine Lands.
Meng Chaoran, the master of Zizhuyuan, is the youngest among the ten disciples. He is indifferent by nature and has no fight with the world. He never argued with the nine senior brothers, and he only had three disciples in his life: Shi Qianshan, Chu Yang, and Tan Tan.
Except for Shi Qianshan who had to accept them out of love, Chu Yang and Tan Tan were both orphans picked up by Meng Chaoran.
Among each generation of disciples, ten top disciples will be selected from among the inner disciples to serve as helmsmen of their respective Nine Peaks and One Garden. The eldest brother among the ten disciples is the future leader of the Tianwai Building, and he occupies Juyun Peak.
Regardless of the elixir resources or the concentration of spiritual energy, Juyun Peak is the first among the nine peaks.
For the position of these ten disciples, the disciples of Jiufeng Yiyuan have been fighting with each other for hundreds of years; everyone has worked hard for these ten places. Under such encouragement and pressure, the disciples of Tianwai Tower also improved by leaps and bounds.
This world is called Jiuchongtian Continent. Where Tianwai Tower is located is the next three days. It is also called "Xiatian Continent". In the eyes of ordinary people, there are several mysterious places in Xiatian Continent, which are filled with clouds and mist all year round and cannot be approached by humans, animals, or even birds.
Only some highly skilled warriors know that there is the entrance to transcend the three days of transcendence and enter the middle three days.
In Zhongsansan, there is also such a mysterious place. This is the entrance to Shangsantian!
If you want to enter, you must have the ability to transcend the world you are in!
Jiuchongtian Continent, as its name suggests, is an extremely huge continent. From east to west, it has never been known how far it is. From south to north, there has never been any record of how far it is. Endless!
In this vast continent, there are countless legends and countless myths, which are passed down from generation to generation. Since ancient times, there have been countless emperors and generals, and heroes have emerged in endlessly.
Today we can enjoy singing and dancing with gold bottles and red wine, but in the future we will be on death row with iron locks. Today's emperor may not be tomorrow's defeated general, a ghost under the sword. Today's bandits, who says they won't be overlords in yellow robes tomorrow?
In this magical continent, anything can happen!
Like any continental planet, outside the court, there are also fringes, wanderers, and charlatans. There are rivers and lakes, there are pros and cons, there are good and evil.
There is no coexistence between good and evil, and there are endless struggles between them. In the long struggle, each of them also formed their own systematic rules of conduct, and sometimes they were turned upside down in a certain period of time, or they could live in peace for hundreds of years in a certain period of time.
Things in the world are so wonderful.
Regardless of good or evil, in the eyes of ordinary people, there is a common title: martial arts warrior!
A chivalrous person uses force to break the law, no matter what world he is in, it is the same principle. Wu, this word, contains thousands of things. The most memorable thing among them is nothing more than the word violence!
One word of disagreement, seven steps to splatter blood, this is martial arts. Crossing the sword with a horse and making achievements is called martial arts. Indulging yourself in the world, killing people and stealing goods, is for the sake of martial arts...
Wushu is colorful and full of disputes.
In addition to humans, there are also some mysterious races in this world, such as the three-star saint race of heaven and earth people. It is said that many years ago, it was once glorious and had unique talents. It also competed with humans for world supremacy and rivalry. But it declined a long time ago.
Or there are other races, but those are more ethereal than legends...
At least, Chu Yang had seen only a handful of them in his previous life. And they're all low-levelOf the saints, as for the advanced ones, none of them have been seen. I don’t know if it is completely extinct or if it is hidden somewhere...
And human warriors, regardless of whether they are good or evil, fingers, palms, legs, feet, fists, knives, swords, etc., all types, from disciple, scholar, practitioner, teacher, sect, respecter, king, emperor (emperor), monarch, saint... The last and supreme one is the Supreme!
There are eleven levels, and each level is divided into grades one to nine.
Fist and palm skills are collectively called martial arts. Martial disciple, warrior, warrior, martial master, Martial Master, Martial Lord, Martial King, Martial Emperor, Martial Lord, Martial Saint.
In terms of the way of swordsmanship, they are swordsmen, swordsmen, and... swordsmen!
Only the way of swordsmanship is the same at the beginning, but at the emperor level, it is "Emperor"; this is the rule of the first Nine Tribulations Sword Master, no one knows why.
Once you reach the Saint level, you are basically at the top of the world! Because from ancient times to the present, there are very few who can become the Supreme! It can be said that the Supreme is a myth! According to legend, at the supreme level, one can command wind and rain to travel across the sky, move mountains, fill seas, and shatter the void!
But legends are always just legends. No one has ever seen it with their own eyes! Even at the Saint level, the dragon has always seen its beginning but not its end. Rarely seen.
